Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in proposing a polaron-like coupled ion–lattice–electron picture, revealed via DFT and in situ synchrotron analysis, where migrating Cu+ ions form transient polaron-like states acting as tunable migration switches.
